predecessors.text: 'Orléans appanage given to Louis I de Valois' (1392)

successors.name: Royal domain of France
successors.text: 'Valois (alienated in 1386?) and Orléans (alienated in 1392) back to the royal domain' (1498, the new king's crowning)

rulers.name: Louis II, Duke of Orléans (Louis XII)

ledger.x: 4 June 1392: Charles VI creates the second dukedom of Orléans for his brother Louis.
23 November 1407: Louis of Orléans is murdered and his son Charles becomes duke.
1498: the duchy merges into the crown when Louis XII is crowned.
1498: the Valois-Orléans duchy ends as a separate state.

certainty.note: An apanage with no boundary record on the pages.
